description: Create a medication tapering schedule tracker with dose calculations, pill inventory management, and symptom log. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/prednisone_taper_raw.xlsx containing a 28-day taper schedule. Add formulas in Column C to calculate pills to take (dose/5), Column D for cumulative pills used, Column E for pills remaining, and Column F header for symptom notes. Add summary calculations below the table for total pills needed, pills remaining after taper, and taper status (sufficient/refill needed). Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
